name: Simple Fatoora
author: Future Base

sections.description:
Simple Fatoora is an automated e‑invoicing solution developed by Future Base. This plugin helps WooCommerce stores comply with ZATCA Phase 2 regulations by generating simplified and standard VAT‑compliant invoices with Phase 2 QR codes.

Key features:
* Automatic invoice creation on order events
* ZATCA Phase 2 compliant QR codes
* Support for simplified and standard tax invoices
* Configurable terms & conditions and custom notes
* Order‑level invoice tracking and links in admin

This plugin communicates with the Simple Fatoora service to generate and store invoice data. An API key from your Simple Fatoora account is required.

External services

This plugin connects to the Simple Fatoora API to validate your API key and to create invoices and credit notes for WooCommerce orders. This connection is required for the plugin to function.

  • What is the service and what is it used for:

    • Simple Fatoora provides an API used to generate ZATCA Phase 2 compliant invoices and QR codes.

  • What data is sent and when:

    • When you save settings: your API key is sent to validate it (to ensure it is active and belongs to your account).
    • When an invoice or credit note is generated: order details necessary for invoice issuance are sent. Depending on your WooCommerce setup, this can include order ID/reference, order line items and quantities, unit prices, discounts, taxes, shipping totals, store information (such as seller name and VAT number), and customer billing/shipping details as required by invoicing regulations. The exact fields depend on the products and tax configuration in your store.

  • Endpoints contacted by the plugin:

    • Validate API key: https://api.simplefatoora.com/sdk/users/validate_user_api_key
    • Create invoice/credit note: https://api.simplefatoora.com/sdk/invoice/create

  • Service provider and policies:

    • Service: Simple Fatoora — https://simplefatoora.com/
    • Terms of Service: https://simplefatoora.com/termsandconditions
    • Privacy Policy: https://simplefatoora.com/privacypolicy

Compatibility

  • WooCommerce 5.2+
  • WordPress 5.2+
  • PHP 7.4+
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/simple-fatoora or install via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Simple Fatoora tab and enter your API key.
  4. Configure options such as auto sync, terms & conditions, and custom notes.
sections.faq:
Do I need an account?

Yes. You need a Simple Fatoora account and API key. Visit our website to sign up.

Where do invoices appear?

Links and status appear in the WooCommerce order list and order details screens.

Does this store personal data?

The plugin stores invoice references associated with WooCommerce orders. Invoice generation occurs via the Simple Fatoora API per your configuration.
